parts.t: What are the six official communities in Surrey, BC?
The City of Surrey is divided into six town centres/communities: Whalley / City Centre (North Surrey), Guildford, Fleetwood, Newton, Cloverdale, and South Surrey.

How will the Surrey-Langley SkyTrain affect Surrey neighbourhoods?

The 16-kilometre Expo Line extension along Fraser Highway adds rapid transit stations through Whalley (140 Street), Fleetwood (152, 160, and 166 Streets), and Clayton/Cloverdale (184 and 190 Streets) en route to Langley City Centre, accompanied by Transit-Oriented Areas density zones.
What school district covers Surrey, BC?

Surrey School District 36 (SD36) is British Columbia's largest public school district, operating more than 100 elementary schools and 21 secondary schools across the six communities, including IB programs at Semiahmoo Secondary and Guildford Park Secondary and French Immersion cohorts citywide.
Are basement suites and multiplexes legal on Surrey single-family lots?

City of Surrey zoning permits registered secondary suites in detached houses, coach homes in designated zones such as Clayton RF-12c/RF-13, and up to 3–6 small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) units on qualifying urban residential lots under provincial Bill 44 rules.
Which board governs MLS® listings in Surrey?
Surrey sits within the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board (FVREB) jurisdiction alongside White Rock, North Delta, Langley, Abbotsford, and Mission.
